plan: Represent recipes and requests as plain dicts with fractions.Fraction quantities; print_original returns authored_text verbatim and no function mutates inputs (fresh dicts everywhere, deepcopy for opaque component fields).
Compute an exact Fraction scale factor target_yield/recipe_yield and apply it to every ingredient quantity, including substitution-introduced additional ingredients.

Resolve each excluded ingredient with a chain-following loop: pick the catalog choice minimizing (priority, catalog index), apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation, record wording and equipment operations, and repeat while the replacement name is still excluded; detect cycles with a per-chain seen-set.

Queue additional ingredients from substitution results through the same resolver so reintroduced exclusions are substituted or reported, with a warning when a substitution introduces an excluded name; a global step cap turns mutually re-introducing catalogs into a cycle reason.

Collect impossibility reasons exhaustively (no substitution for NAME, substitution cycle involving NAME, equipment NAME unavailable) without short-circuiting, then return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons} with sorted warnings/reasons, ordered choice IDs, sorted final equipment, and wording changes applied to instruction strings.
mechanisms: Accumulator context object (_Adaptation) carrying choices, warnings, reasons, wording edits, equipment ops, and yield factor across the whole adaptation
Deterministic catalog selection by min (priority, catalog index)
Chain-following substitution resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
Work-queue processing of substitution-introduced additional ingredients through the same resolver
Exhaustive non-short-circuiting reason collection into a set, sorted on output
Exact rational arithmetic via fractions.Fraction for scaling and factors
Copy-on-adapt construction (fresh dicts, deepcopy of components) guaranteeing input immutability
Ordered wording-change application via string replacement over authored instruction strings
